candidates.name: Time Ontology in OWL
verified_facts: Time Ontology in OWL describes temporal properties, ordering relationships, temporal positions and durations for resources identified on the Web.
It provides a semantic model for temporal information.
semantic_limits: A modeled temporal relation or timestamp field does not by itself prove the actual acquisition time, survey epoch or currency of terrain source data.

candidates.name: OGC Web Services Context Document
verified_facts: OWS Context describes a portable collection of configured information resources and services that can be passed between applications.
The standard supports service collections and in-line content through context encodings.
semantic_limits: Application context does not prove the referenced source bytes, acquisition lineage, parcel geometry or vertical accuracy used in a numeric result.
